description: This file defines the 'Guarantor' entity class within a loan management system, representing guarantors associated with loan accounts. It includes fields for guarantor details, relationships to other domain objects, and methods for creating, updating, and managing guarantor data.

classes.name: Guarantor
classes.description: Entity representing a guarantor associated with a loan, including personal details, relationships, and funding information, with capabilities for creation and update.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Guarantor object from JSON command input, initializing properties based on guarantor type and funding details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates properties of the Guarantor entity based on a JSON command, tracking actual changes.

methods.name: isExistingCustomer
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor is an existing customer.

methods.name: isExistingEmployee
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor is an existing employee.

methods.name: isExternalGuarantor
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor is external.

methods.name: handlePropertyUpdate
methods.description: Helper method to handle updates to integer, string, or date properties based on JSON command input.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the guarantor.

methods.name: getLoanId
methods.description: Returns the loan ID associated with the guarantor.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID from the associated loan.

methods.name: getOfficeId
methods.description: Returns the office ID from the associated loan.

methods.name: getClientRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the client relationship type code value.

methods.name: updateClientRelationshipType
methods.description: Updates the client relationship type.

methods.name: updateExistingEntityToNull
methods.description: Reset the entity ID to null, indicating it no longer references an existing entity.

methods.name: getGurantorType
methods.description: Returns the guarantor type.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the guarantor is active.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the activity status of the guarantor.

methods.name: addFundingDetails
methods.description: Adds funding details to the guarantor.

methods.name: updateStatus(GuarantorFundingDetails, GuarantorFundStatusType)
methods.description: Updates the funding status of a specific funding detail.

methods.name: getGuarantorFundingDetail
methods.description: Retrieves a specific funding detail by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs update of guarantor properties based on JSON input, tracking what changed.

methods.name: hasGuarantor
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor has a guarantee linked to a specific savings account.

methods.name: isSelfGuarantee
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor is self-guarantee (the guarantor is the same as the borrower).
